title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – Month End Accruals for GRNI Purchase Orders and Unposted Purchase Invoices
summary: This post explains how to identify and accrue for unposted purchase invoices and goods received not invoiced (GRNI) purchase orders at month end using the Purchase Lines page in Analysis Mode, then post accruals through a Recurring General Journal.
key_points: Use Purchase Lines page with Analysis Mode to filter unposted invoices (Document Type = Invoice, Type = G/L Account) and GRNI orders (Document Type = Order, Type = G/L Account, Amt. Rcd. Not Inv. Ex. VAT <>0)
Apply date filters to exclude invoices from later periods and use the Pivot Function to summarize by GL code if needed
Export filtered data to Excel and populate a Recurring General Journal to post month-end accruals and reversals
This approach applies only to G/L Account line items; items can use Expected Costing in Inventory Setup for automatic accrual posting

quotes.text: At the month end, you might have Purchase Invoices that are unposted for a variety of reasons.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the business problem that accruals solve for proper period expense recording

quotes.text: I tend to use Analysis Mode much more since the feature Add fields in Analysis Mode was added.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that Analysis Mode is the recommended approach for creating ad-hoc month-end reports
